title: Offer
description: A commercial offer for an educational program, course, or certification.

price.description: The price of the offer in the specified currency.

priceCurrency.description: The ISO 4217 currency code for the price.

category.description: Whether the offer covers the course, certification only, or both.

paymentFrequency.description: The payment frequency used by the MOOChub profile.

availabilityStarts.description: The RFC 3339 date-time at which the offer becomes available.

availabilityEnds.description: The RFC 3339 date-time at which the offer is no longer available.

url.description: A booking, checkout, enrollment, or access URL for this offer.
